ASCII.subject: Computer & IT
ASCII.question: What is ASCII? Character encoding standard.
ASCII.fact: ASCII ( ASS-kee), an acronym for American Standard Code for Information Interchange, is a character encoding standard for representing a particular set of 95 (English-language–focused) printable and 33 control characters – a total of 128 code points.   ASCII hugely influenced the design of character sets used by modern computers; for example, the first 128 code points of Unicode are the same as ASCII.

ASCII art.subject: Computer & IT
ASCII art.question: The _____ was Computer art form using text characters.
ASCII art.fact: ASCII art is a graphic design technique that uses computers for presentation and consists of pictures pieced together from the 95 printable (from a total of 128) characters defined by the ASCII Standard from 1963 and ASCII compliant character sets with proprietary extended characters (beyond the 128 characters of standard 7-bit ASCII). ASCII art can be created with any text editor, and is often used with free-form languages.
